svg.title: TAGS-2 Things pre-build S24+ synthetic layout board, 12 states
svg.desc: Twelve annotated 384 by 832 dp Atlas screen sketches, each equivalent to 1080 by 2340 px at 2.8125 px per dp. Light/dark, navigation, Things, result facets, loading, partial, empty, error, huge list and large-font keyboard state. Synthetic vector image proxies, not app screenshots.
